common.pagePurpose: This page exists for a simple reason: to explain in under two minutes why I thought it would be relevant to contact you directly.
common.objectifValue: Understand if a collaboration makes sense
common.profileDifferent: What makes my background a bit different
common.why15min: Why I propose a simple 15-minute exchange
common.why15minText1: I don't yet know if my profile really matches your needs.
common.why15minText2: I also don't know if your environment matches what I'm looking for.
common.why15minText3: That's precisely why I propose a simple 15-minute exchange.
common.why15minText4: The goal is not to convince at all costs.
common.why15minText5: The goal is to verify if a conversation is worth pursuing.
common.ctaText1: Do you think a 15-minute exchange could make sense?
common.ctaText2: If the answer is no, I will understand perfectly.
common.ctaText3: If the answer is maybe, I'd be happy to discuss it.

executive.title: Why your company needs me

executive.whyContactDetail: This is precisely what caught my attention and what I can concretely contribute.
executive.longDetail: After more than twenty years of understanding complex environments, processes, and organizations, I want to put this analytical ability at the service of commercial development and value creation.

business-development.title: Why your growth deserves more than a classic salesperson
business-development.whyContact: {company} is looking to develop its business with a structured and innovative approach.
business-development.whyContactDetail: This is precisely where my hybrid background in acquisition, automation, and growth makes perfect sense.
business-development.longDetail: After more than twenty years of building pipelines, automating processes, and generating opportunities, I now put this expertise at the service of B2B commercial development. My approach combines data, tools, and strategy to create value quickly.

rh.title: Why your HR department needs me

faq.question: Why go back to school today?
faq.answer: To formalize my skills in B2B commercial development and acquisition, while continuing to apply this training directly in the field.

faq.question: Why choose an apprenticeship?
faq.answer: It's the best way to quickly create value for a company, while benefiting from a structured learning framework.

faq.question: Do you want to continue after the diploma?
faq.answer: Absolutely. I'm looking for an environment where I can contribute in the long term, not just for the duration of the apprenticeship.

faq.question: Would you accept being supervised?
faq.answer: Of course. Even with my experience, I still have a lot to learn in the commercial field. Good supervision accelerates skill development.

faq.question: Are you really looking for a sales career?
faq.answer: Yes, it's a natural evolution of my journey. After spending years understanding systems and processes, I now want to create value directly with clients and partners.

business.problem: Structuring and qualifying a large volume of data to obtain actionable contacts.
business.why: What interests me about this result is not the volume. It's the ability to transform a mass of data into actionable opportunities.

business.problem: A prospecting campaign has no value if the messages don't arrive.
business.result: Score increased from 4.6 to 10/10 in a few days.
business.why: Because before improving conversion, you first need to exist in the inbox.

business.problem: Some repetitive tasks consume a disproportionate amount of energy.
business.why: The time saved can then be devoted to commercial exchanges and high-value actions.

growth.problem: Many professionals gradually discover topics related to data, tools, or automation.
growth.action: My journey followed the reverse path: I started with systems, then applications, then processes, then acquisition.
growth.why: Over time, I've realized that growth isn't just about traffic or volume. It's mainly about the ability to identify the right problems and build simple solutions.

growth.action: Identify the right problems and build simple solutions.
growth.why: This logic is what leads me today towards commercial development and account management.

executive.problem: After more than twenty years in technical and operational environments, finding an environment where I can contribute quickly.
executive.action: Resume a training path while applying it directly in the field.
executive.why: Because commercial and business functions are progressively taking a central place in what motivates me: understanding a need, creating value, developing an activity, moving a project forward.

executive.problem: I'm not just looking for an apprenticeship.
executive.action: I'm looking for an environment where I can contribute quickly.
executive.result: Desire to build for the long term.
executive.why: A profile that doesn't fit a traditional box can sometimes bring exactly the cross-functional vision an organization needs.
